figurative_meaning_en: to spin or feel dizzy (as if the world is revolving)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মাথা ঘুরছে, সে সামলে উঠতে পারছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His head is spinning, he can't steady himself.
The car's spin made my eyes whirl.
history: References the heliocentric model where the Earth revolves around the stationary Sun, contrasting ancient geocentric beliefs and highlighting scientific advancements like those of Copernicus.
note: The idiom ties into modern scientific understanding of planetary motion, often used figuratively for disorientation.
